title: Make the e word joke explicit and absorb the letters in bubble smoke
statement: User requested Adobe → A dobe e → A dope e → a dope e, wide tracking, visible b-to-p morph, white bubbly smoke and other letters folding into e. Implemented the film on a contrast-controlled stage while preserving the selected final character.
conditions: Current user brief explicitly extends the prior film.
Static visual checks and timing tests do not establish interactive browser QA.
